The server binds to `127.0.0.1` and reads the port from the `PORT` environment variable, defaulting to `3000`.\n\nVerify it is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\n# {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\n## Entry point and major files\n\n- **`server.js`** — Entry point. Creates the HTTP server, wires the route table via `lib/router.js`, and starts listening. It calls `db.initDb()` at startup.\n- **`lib/router.js`** — Minimal HTTP router. Routes are registered in order and matched by HTTP method and regex. Captured path segments are spread as positional arguments to the handler.\n- **`lib/db.js`** — Persistence layer.
